Bash(node -e "const en = require\(''./frontend/messages/en.json''\); const ar = require\(''./frontend/messages/ar.json''\); const countKeys = \(obj, prefix=''''\) => { let keys = []; for \(const [k,v] of Object.entries\(obj\)\) { if \(typeof v === ''object'' && v !== null\) { keys.push\(...countKeys\(v, prefix+k+''.''\)\); } else { keys.push\(prefix+k\); } } return keys; }; const enKeys = countKeys\(en\); const arKeys = countKeys\(ar\); console.log\(''EN keys:'', enKeys.length\); console.log\(''AR keys:'', arKeys.length\); const missing = enKeys.filter\(k => !arKeys.includes\(k\)\); const extra = arKeys.filter\(k => !enKeys.includes\(k\)\); if \(missing.length\) console.log\(''Missing in AR:'', missing\); if \(extra.length\) console.log\(''Extra in AR:'', extra\); if \(!missing.length && !extra.length\) console.log\(''All keys match!''\);")

Bash(node -e "const en=JSON.parse\(require\(''fs''\).readFileSync\(''frontend/messages/en.json'',''utf8''\)\);const ar=JSON.parse\(require\(''fs''\).readFileSync\(''frontend/messages/ar.json'',''utf8''\)\);function ck\(o,p\){let r=[];for\(let k in o\){if\(typeof o[k]===''object''&&o[k]!==null\)r.push\(...ck\(o[k],p+k+''.''\)\);else r.push\(p+k\);}return r;}const ek=ck\(en,''''\),ak=ck\(ar,''''\);console.log\(''EN:'',ek.length,''AR:'',ak.length\);const m=ek.filter\(x=>ak.indexOf\(x\)<0\);const e=ak.filter\(x=>ek.indexOf\(x\)<0\);if\(m.length\)console.log\(''Missing:'',m\);if\(e.length\)console.log\(''Extra:'',e\);if\(m.length===0&&e.length===0\)console.log\(''All keys match''\);")
